messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 DETECTED p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). p99 jumped 190ms -> 2.7s over last 5m. streaming tail stalls up. Paging alice_oncall. Grafana: https://grafana.example.com/d/abc/latency?orgId=1
alice_oncall: on it — joining huddle now. starting quick checks.
raj_sre: seeing a KV cache eviction burst coincident with spike, miss rate up ~18% -> 64%. running a quick PromQL: 
```
sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)
```
maria_runtime: runtime logs show repeated GPU worker restarts on node gpu-eu-03 around the same time: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:03:21Z] gpu0: kernel OOM, worker restart
[2026-03-15T14:04:07Z] grpc: streaming stall detected, send timeout
```
kevin_prod: any confirmed customer impact yet? need to know who to notify.
sam_support: receiving support flags — two customers reported elevated timeouts: AcmeCorp (EU region, dedicated) and BetaApps (hosted, EU). both complaining ~10-15% request timeouts over last 7m. support ticket IDs created.
alice_oncall: mitigation plan proposal: 1) temporarily divert affected accounts to fallback region (us-west) / route-shift 2) increase eu runtime pool by +2 replicas 3) disable continuous batching for streaming endpoints to reduce tail queuing 4) kick off rolling restart of gpu-eu nodes if evictions persist. agree?
lucy_eng: I can patch autoscaler and push a one-off scale: `kubectl scale deployment/redwood-runtime-eu --replicas=6` — will also add a traffic-split rule to send AcmeCorp -> us-west as a canary.
raj_sre: quick diagnostic checklist I ran: 
- p95 stable ~210ms, p99 spike to 2.7s
- kvcache hit-rate dropped 78% -> 42%
- batch size distribution shows spikes to 512 for streaming routes
PromQL snippets I used:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```
maria_runtime: looks like one GPU host started thrashing which led to queue pressure and larger batches piling up. could be a driver/kernel regression pushed in last infra rollout. I recommend rolling restart of gpu-eu-0* nodes and revert last infra kernel patch if we confirm.
skevin_prod: (typo in name fixed) kevin_prod: I'll prep an interim customer message: short note to AcmeCorp/BetaApps that we're investigating elevated latency and may route traffic temporarily. Sam, pls coordinate text.
sam_support: sending AcmeCorp note now, asked for logs and timestamps. pinged BetaApps with ETA ~15m. will update tickets. :loud_sound:
alice_oncall: executing mitigations: 1) lucy scaling now, 2) raj throttling low-priority routes, 3) maria doing node restarts if evictions unchanged after scale. please confirm when done.
lucy_eng: scaled to 6 replicas — verified pods are Ready. applying traffic-split for AcmeCorp -> us-west (10% incrementally).
raj_sre: throttled low-priority routes; reduced batch window for streaming to 10ms for eu pool. watching metrics.
maria_runtime: started rolling restart on gpu-eu-03 and gpu-eu-04 (one at a time). monitoring kernel logs for recurrence.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-1781234999 created and linked to runbook: https://infra.runbooks/redwood/incidents/1781234999
alice_oncall: quick customer impact summary for postmortem: ~5-12% of EU requests experienced timeouts depending on tenant, AcmeCorp saw increased 504s; p99 elevated for ~12 minutes with tail stalls. mitigation actions: scale + route shift + node restarts.
kevin_prod: noted — will draft comms for affected customers post-incident.
sam_support: updated both tickets with mitigation steps and asked for confirmation after route shift.
raj_sre: current numbers after scale & throttles: p99 down to 460ms and trending down, kvcache hit-rate recovering slowly (now 58%). keeping watch for kernel OOM repeats.
alice_oncall: ok folks — continue monitoring for another 20m. if p99 < 300ms and no new OOMs for 10m, move to recovery status. assigning follow-ups: raj_sre (kvcache root cause), maria_runtime (kernel/driver), lucy_eng (autoscaler config), sam_support (customer updates), kevin_prod (postmortem draft). :white_check_mark:
lucy_eng: noted and capturing config diffs. :eyes:
end of thread.
